opportunities.title: Small Grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel awards up to £2,000 (≤13 days) or £2,500 (14+ days) per person; up to £5,000 for PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more; Japan office up to ¥300,000 for PhD students.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects. Projects must bring people in the UK and Japan together.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits/exchange. UK office holds three annual awards meetings (deadlines 31 March, 15 September, 15 December); Japan office holds two (28 February, 30 September).

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Awards of up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to health and medical professionals, researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in the UK and Japan. Applicants should normally show an existing research record. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs. Annual deadline 1 December for a decision in March of the following year.
